reason: The capped headcount, shoes off and the daily cleaning log are exactly what I check for, so I'd use the free first visit and probably pay for one more drop-in if it's as clean as claimed. I wouldn't commit to a membership until I'd seen it myself.
objection: $13 a visit adds up fast when library storytime and the parks cost nothing, and I'd need to see the place really is as clean as the log says.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it spotless in person on the free visit, plus good reviews from other parents.
